· Position vs SMA100/200 ($82.07/$68.25) — Above long-term trends, strong upward momentum.

· RSI Trajectory (34.5→54.0) + Exited oversold, consolidating in neutral zone + Upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.8441→0.9086) + Improvement diagnosed + Potential trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $86.10) + Bandwidth 33.69% indicates a period of expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($97.84) + Potential to challenge 52-week high upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + Interpreted as a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.22x) + Low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Early stage of uptrend) + Buy entry condition upon breaking initial resistance.
